title: Measuring What Matters: A Framework for Evaluating Safety Risks in Real-World LLM Applications

bias_targets.target: Discriminatory bias (Race, Religion, Nationality, Gender, Age)
bias_targets.methodology: Probing the LLM application with a curated benchmark of adversarial prompts targeting protected identities and evaluating the safe refusal rate using automated evaluators like LLM-as-a-judge, custom classifiers, or keyword matching.
Submitting targeted adversarial prompts discussing domestic politics, geopolitics, and social policies to measure whether the LLM application maintains a safe, apolitical stance via refusal metrics.

Incorporating localized vocabulary (e.g., 'Singlish') and culturally specific norms into adversarial prompts to evaluate the robustness of safety filters against non-Western-centric linguistic and cultural nuances.
